summary: Agnico Eagle Mines filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing approval of an investment decision for its Hope Bay gold project in Nunavut, Canada. The release describes a preliminary economic assessment for an underground mine with expected annual gold production of 400,000-435,000 ounces over an initial 11-year mine life. No transaction with another entity, stake purchase, tender offer, or shareholder vote is involved. This is an internal capital allocation decision, not a special situation. The document is a routine disclosure of a project development milestone.
